calibration.selection_rule: lowest mean 1000-step training loss over two calibration seeds

limitations: The effective state size is 16 because exact saved Figure counts show the nominal sd1 argument was not applied.
The source records no original seeds; this reproduction supplies deterministic seeds.
The fixed evaluation uses 2,048 held-out sequences per seed instead of the public loop's eight examples.
Normal 95% intervals summarize variability across 11 headline seeds; the 10th/90th quantiles match the paper's reporting convention.
The 0.90 first-hit frontier is a finite calibrated sweep over the explicitly listed dimensions, not an asymptotic lower bound.

source_contracts.imported_claim_difference: The imported claim says the pure models need approximately 12000 parameters to match perfect accuracy, whereas the paper caption explicitly says they reach only around 0.9.
source_contracts.paper_caption: At 2000 parameters hybrids consistently attain perfect accuracy; pure models with 6x parameters attain around 0.9.

verdict_basis: The finite converged runs did not establish the strict separation needed to verify or falsify the imported wording.
